Versus AI now starts with the same style of game-type grid as Local Versus. Choose 8-ball, 9-ball, 10-ball, straight pool, blackball, snooker, six-red snooker, carom or three-cushion, then enter the Amateur tour. The chosen rules continue through all 48 rivals, retries and manual saves. Practice stays solo and is disabled in the AI grid.

Save files now retain the championship game type, including in-flight snooker shots and the second carom cue. Existing version-5 8-ball saves still load. Save rows and local high scores identify their game type. The existing global board remains for comparable 8-ball championships; other game types do not post to it. This is stated on the selection screen.

Validation: all nine modes passed AI placement/shooting, intro and rolling saves, loading, rival progression and global-board gating checks. Native input checks selected and started 9-ball, snooker and three-cushion from the new screen. Tests use isolated player data.

Linux x86-64. Source and original artwork: Apache-2.0; bundled media retains NOTICE terms. Gamepad access in Snap: `sudo snap connect the-last-pocket:joystick`.
